_doc: Item weight model (docs/plans/weight-cost-sweep.md 2b), read by C++ item_weight() (fight_core/itemeconomy.cpp) and Fenia .itemWeight(obj). weight = reference kg for the slot (armor, clothing), weapon class or item type x density ratio of the material inside its own family (rho / family rho, clamped to ratio) x heft (armor and clothing: the heft prop, else medium; a coverage prop c in percent counts as c / coverage_ref) x two_hands (a two_hands weapon whose class has no kg_2h and is not inherent_2h). kg is a number or a map by family with an optional default. haft = share of a weapon that is a wooden haft, which the head material does not scale. Several materials split the piece 2^(n-1) : ... : 2 : 1, the first one main. blocks: solid lumps by type, a block of length x width x thickness mm times rho. drink adds liquid_units per unit of liquid left. max_kg caps an entry (food by hours); worn_uses_slot: a worn item of that type (boots of water walking) weighs by its slot. Result in 1/10 lb (unit_grams), at least min_units. A non-zero <weight> in the area file overrides the model.

migration._doc: One-shot rewrite of saved instances in fread_obj (pfiles, object bank, saved rooms, charmed mobs). rev: the model revision; an object saved with a lower EconRev is migrated once. mode: off (nothing), dry (log what would change, change nothing, keep the old rev), apply. An object still shaped like its prototype (type, material, weapon class and hands, no own heft or coverage) takes the prototype's weight, a reshaped one (random loot, crafts) the model's. Cost never rises: generated (measure_m) min(own, cost_k x M x level), other hand-made min(own, prototype cost), both capped; tier without measure_m keeps its own. Skipped: non-take, corpses, boats, weight_exempt_vnums (lure 30, quest logs) for weight; cost 0 (pit), money, katana, personal-shop items (psCost) for cost. Changing the model (this file, or a material rho in material.json) leaves every saved on-model item off the model, and Fenia .tmp.weight.effectWeight then reads it raw: bump rev to re-weigh them, and re-solve the effect scale table (dreamland_fenia_public utils/weight effectWeightScale, scripts/weight-cost-census.py drift line).
